settings.headline: Advanced is the everyday. Professional is the upgrade.
settings.body: Microneedling is the procedure most clients underestimate when picking a numbing strength. Sessions run longer than injection appointments. The needles cover broad treatment areas across the full face. Skin gets worked across a wider zone for a sustained period. Advanced Strength is built for exactly that — the longer session, the more sensitive treatment area, the appointment that asks more of your preparation. Professional sits one step above for the most intensive sessions or the most sensitive skin. Clinical is rarely enough on its own.
settings.image_alt: Editorial close-up of Senseless Advanced Strength cream

settings.headline: Microneedling is one of the procedures where gel earns its place.
settings.body: Most aesthetic appointments are short enough that cream is the natural format. Microneedling is the exception. Sessions are long enough that some clients prefer the gel format — it sits differently on the skin and suits the sustained preparation a microneedling appointment asks for. Same strengths, different application. Choose by personal preference or by your practitioner's protocol.

settings.headline: Microneedling earns its preparation.
settings.body: Most aesthetic procedures are short enough that the preparation question almost answers itself. Microneedling is different. A full-face session, sustained needle work, broad treatment area — preparation isn't an optional add-on for most clients. Senseless is formulated to suit the kind of preparation microneedling actually demands.

settings.question: Which strength is best for microneedling?
settings.answer: Advanced Strength is the everyday recommendation. Microneedling is longer and more intensive than most aesthetic appointments. Professional for the most demanding sessions or the most sensitive skin. Clinical is rarely enough on its own.

settings.question: Cream or gel for microneedling?
settings.answer: Both fit. Cream is the default format. Gel is the genuine alternative for sustained preparation — microneedling is the procedure where the gel format has a structural advantage over cream.

settings.question: When do I apply it before microneedling?
settings.answer: Ahead of your appointment. Microneedling typically asks for longer preparation than injection-based appointments. Your practitioner is the best guide for the specific protocol they recommend.

settings.question: Will my practitioner reapply during the session?
settings.answer: Many do. Microneedling sessions are long enough that some practitioners apply additional preparation at the chair. Ask your practitioner about their approach.

settings.question: Is Senseless safe for the whole face?
settings.answer: Senseless is formulated for facial skin as preparation before aesthetic appointments. Follow your practitioner's guidance for the specific zones treated during your session.

settings.question: Is this a medicine?
settings.answer: No. Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not a pharmacy product.
